observation.command:
TOKEN=$(curl -sS -m 30 "https://codeberg.org/v2/token?service=container_registry&scope=*" | sed 's/.*"token":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/')
for REPO in open_taki opentaki; do
  echo "=== $REPO tags ==="
  curl -sS -m 30 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://codeberg.org/v2/kosmos-eu/$REPO/tags/list" | head -c 2000
  echo
done
